node.statement: The dependency objection is decisive. Validated node 1.2 is explicitly conditional on an all-amplification square lower bound. The proposed supplier 1.4.3.1.1.1 is pending and has an open challenge because the registered definitions do not include the definition of an extended epsilon-C*-algebra needed to unfold lem-compcb-corner-algebra into that bound. Node 1.3 is pending, so neither a_{2n}>=a_n/2 nor a_n>=a_m for n<=m is currently available. Node 1.4.2 is also pending; moreover its literal a_1>=1/4<r_- contradicts the validated estimate r_-<1/8 from node 1.4.1. The mathematically correct base exclusion would be a_1>=1/4>r_-, but it cannot be imported before a corrected base node and its square premise are validated. Therefore the original induction claim is withdrawn, exactly as stated in the amended parent, and the ancestor remains unproved rather than being supported by unavailable premises.
